blocks_element.text: Premature hair aging is a multifaceted problem caused by several biological mechanisms happening at once. Pigment cells are slowing down, follicle anchorage is weakening, and oxidative stress is accelerating it all. A single-target solution may only address one of these symptoms or temporarily mask the visible presentation of them. By targeting key biological pathways associated with visible signs of premature hair aging like oxidative stress, hair shedding, and hair graying with targeted multi-pathway technology, FutureIQ™ serum addresses the full picture of what's actually driving the visible changes.

Paragraphe · I’ve been testing the K18 FutureIQ for…
blocks_element.text: I’ve been testing the K18 FutureIQ for three months, and I’m pretty happy with the results. My hair journey began two years ago after experiencing postpartum hair loss. I noticed my hair was thinner, I was shedding a lot, and the top area had a lot of breakage. I’m very consistent with using hair products, so I was excited to test the K18 serum! The formula isn’t too runny or too thick. The dropper makes it easy to dispense the product without it spilling or making a mess. It’s easy to apply and absorbs nicely into my scalp. My scalp doesn’t get irritated by the serum, and I haven’t experienced any bad reactions. After three months, I’ve noticed that my hair feels thicker when I gather it in my hand and when I tie it up. When I brush or wash my hair, I’ve also noticed less hair shedding. I do have greys, and during the first few weeks, I didn’t notice any changes. Around the eighth week, I noticed that my greys didn’t seem to appear as quickly. I still had the same greys I started with, but I didn’t notice as many new ones appearing. Overall, I’m happy with this product because my scalp and hair feel healthier, my hair is a bit thicker, and I’ve seen less greys. They are still there but I haven’t seen as many. I received this product as a testing opportunity from Gloss Angeles Confidential.

blocks_element.text: K18 Hair is committed to making our website's content accessible and user friendly to everyone. If you are having difficulty viewing or navigating the content on this website, or notice any content, feature, or functionality that you believe is not fully accessible to people with disabilities, please call our Customer Service team at 844-564-0382 or email our team at hello@k18hair.com with “Disabled Access” in the subject line and provide a description of the specific feature you feel is not fully accessible or a suggestion for improvement. We take your feedback seriously and will consider it as we evaluate ways to accommodate all of our customers and our overall accessibility policies. Additionally, while we do not control such vendors, we strongly encourage vendors of third-party digital content to provide content that is accessible and user friendly.
